data.name: Noohan
data.gender_notes: Noohan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Noohan is derived from the Arabic root 'N-H-N' or 'N-W-H', signifying intelligence, wisdom, or enlightenment. It is associated with being knowledgeable or having a deep understanding. The name Noohan carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise, Enlightened” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Noohan usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, enlightened and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Noohan is linked to the concept of 'Nuh' or 'Noah' in Islamic tradition, symbolizing wisdom, righteousness, and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Noohan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise, Enlightened.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Noohan total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: نوحان
in_arabic.meaning: نوح عليه السلام کا نام، طوفان سے بچنے والا، آرام دہ
in_arabic.long_meaning: نوحان اسم ہے جو نوح عليه السلام سے ماخوذ ہے، جو اللہ کے ایک پیغمبر تھے جنہوں نے طوفان سے بچایا تھا۔ یہ نام ان کی صفات سے لیا گیا ہے، جس میں طوفان سے بچنے والا، آرام دہ اور تسلی بخش meanings ہیں۔ قرآن میں نوح کا ذکر تفصیل سے کیا گیا ہے، اور ان کا قصہ ایک عظیم تحریر ہے۔

in_urdu.name: نوحان
in_urdu.meaning: نوح علیہ السلام کا نام، طوفان سے بچنے والا، آرام دہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: نوحان ایک ایسا نام ہے جو نوح علیہ السلام سے لیا گیا ہے، جو اسلام کی تاریخ میں ایک اہم شخصیت ہیں۔ یہ نام ان کی صفات جیسے کہ طوفان سے بچنے والا، آرام دہ اور تسلی بخش سے ماخوذ ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان یہ نام روایتی اور مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नूहान
in_hindi.meaning: नूह का नाम, तूफान से बचने वाला, आरामदायक
in_hindi.long_meaning: नूहान नाम नूह से लिया गया है, जो इस्लाम में एक महत्वपूर्ण पैगंबर थे। यह नाम उनकी विशेषताओं जैसे तूफान से बचने वाला, आरामदायक और सांत्वना देने वाला से लिया गया है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में यह नाम पारंपरिक और लोकप्रिय है।

in_english.name: Noohan
in_english.meaning: Derived from Noah, meaning rest, comfort, and salvation
in_english.long_meaning: The name Noohan is derived from the Arabic root 'N-W-H' which means rest, comfort, and salvation. It is associated with Prophet Noah, who was saved from a great flood. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies tranquility, peace, and deliverance. Historically, it has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing hope and divine mercy.

data.cultural_impact: The name Noohan carries a rich heritage in Islamic culture, as it is the name of the Prophet Nuh (Noah) in the Holy Quran. Prophet Nuh is considered to be one of the most righteous prophets of God, who was sent to warn mankind of the impending flood that was to be a divine punishment for their disobedience to God. The name Noohan is also associated with "Righteousness" and high moral character.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Noohan lies in its association with wisdom, knowledge, and understanding - qualities considered crucial for accessing the divine will and living a godly life. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Prophet Nuh was blessed with these qualities, allowing him to guide humanity towards the right path. Thus, the name Noohan serves as a reminder for individuals to strive for knowledge and wisdom in their own lives. It also carries the hope of spiritual enlightenment and the development of a deep understanding of God's guidance and wisdom.
